They must be absorbing whatever is in their realm to cause such large mutations!|audio = FrostWave25-2.ogg|[[Professor V]] on Wave 31 ([[Frost Mode|Frost]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Mega Frost Mystery''' is a summoner enemy that appears in the [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. It has a decent amount of health and above average speed. When killed, it will summon five random enemies. ==Logbook Description== "''The Frost Mystery is considered one of the most terrifying creatures in the Frost Realm. It has an exoskeleton made of tough solid ice, while its insides contain water that cannot be frozen. According to legend, these beings are created from those who fall through frozen lakes and never resurface. The shadowy figure visible within is believed to be one of these unfortunate souls. It releases frost enemies with modifiers upon death.''" ==Appearance== The '''Mega''' '''Frost Mystery''' is an entity with an exoskeleton made entirely out of tough, solid ice filled with unfreezable water. Inside its torso, it contains a shadowy figure in it, which has an entirely white body. ==Enemies Spawned== The '''Mega Frost Mystery''' summons five random enemies from a set list, all with their own chances of being chosen. It can summon the following enemies: *[[Yeti]] (27.27% chance, 0.5 delay) *[[Packed Ice]] (27.27% chance, 0.7 delay) *[[Blizzard Wizard]] (18.18% chance, 0.8 delay) *[[Frostbane]] (18.18% chance, 0.8 delay) ==Strategy== *Towers with good DPS, like the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] are recommended against this. **AOE towers like the [[Rocketeer]] or [[Mortar]] can also be useful at clearing out multiple of them at once. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorspeMegaFrostMystery.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version variant (3 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Pulse Trooper Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Mega Frost Mystery''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} DefaultEnemyIconIG.png|'''Mega Frost Mystery''' on its bugged [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Mega Frost Mystery's''' model was originally used by the [[Frost Mystery]] during the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. *The '''Mega Frost Mystery''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''3 December 2025 '''- [[v1.82.0]] **'''Mega Frost Mystery''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Mega Frost Mystery''' has a broken icon. **{{Bug}} '''Mega Frost Mystery's''' model does not load in the [[Index]]. *'''19 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0|v1.82.2]]a **{{Bugfix}} '''Mega Frost Mystery's''' model now loads in the [[Index]]. *'''28 January 2026''' - [[v1.84.0]] **Health decreased from 1,000 to 600 in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **Speed increased from Very Fast (8) to Swift (10). **Cash given decreased from {{Money|2,250}} to {{Money|1,500}} on death. **''Icebreaker'' ability changed. ***Now summons [[Crying Angel]] with a 37.5% chance and [[Snow Golem]] with a 12.5% chance. ***No longer summons [[Frostbane|Permafrost]], [[Cold Mist]] or [[Shivergeist|Frost Wraith]]. ***Enemies now always receive the [[Stun Immunity]] instead of the [[Freeze Immunity]] 50% of the time, [[Health Regen]] 35% of the time and [[Aggro]] 15% of the time. *'''28 August 2026 '''- [[v2.8.0]] **Speed decreased from Swift (10) to Above Average (4). **[[Stun Immunity]] added. **''Icebreaker'' ability changed. ***Now summons the [[Yeti]] with a 27.27% chance and 0.5 delay, [[Packed Ice]] with a 27.27% chance and 0.7 delay, [[Blizzard Wizard]] with an 18.18% chance and 0.8 delay and [[Frostbane]] with an 18.18% chance and 0.8 delay. ***No longer summons the [[Snow Minion]], [[Crying Angel]] and [[Snow Golem]]. ***No longer gives summoned enemies [[Stun Immunity]]. **Size increased. {{FrostMode|[[Deep Freeze]], [[Shivergeist]], & [[Frost Mage]]|Wave 30|Mega Frost Mystery|Wave 31|[[Frost Necromancer]]|Wave 32}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Mid-Game]]
